    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Customers say

    Customers love this fitness watch's appearance and appreciate its many features, including step tracking, sleep monitoring, and heart rate measurement. They find it simple to use, easy to set up, and do everything they're looking for. The battery life receives mixed feedback - while some say it lasts a week between charges, others report needing to charge every 2-3 days. Compatibility is also mixed, with some customers reporting seamless pairing with their phones while others experience connection issues. Accuracy is another mixed aspect, with some finding it very accurate while others say it's not as precise as they'd like.
